FINDING_touch_and_reject_never_matches.observed: 0 of 128 candidates match touch_and_reject, even with ALL matches reported so shadowing is excluded
FINDING_touch_and_reject_never_matches.why: the trigger bar handed to the gate is the SYNTHETIC FORCE ROW - a partial composite of the completed 1m sub-bars inside the still-forming 5m parent - not a completed 5m candle. A forming partial rarely carries a large rejection wick because the wick forms as the candle completes. Single-bar rejection geometry ON THE TRIGGER is therefore looking for a shape that cannot be there yet.
FINDING_touch_and_reject_never_matches.corroboration: prior_momentum_after_rejection matches 60 of 128 - the rejection is on an EARLIER COMPLETED bar, which is exactly what that branch tests for
FINDING_touch_and_reject_never_matches.what_it_does_NOT_mean: it does NOT mean the trader never takes a touch-and-reject. It means this pipeline cannot SEE one on the trigger bar. Whether the frozen teachings intend the rejection to be read on the completed prior bar is a question for the textbook, not for this checkpoint - and this checkpoint may not answer it.
